name: Batch 20 · From the selectors
status: Published to Spotify and atomically appended to hosted Playlist Lab. Exact order, 15 unrated candidates and old feedback preservation verified. Candidates are not party approvals.

selection_policy.authorization: Host October 30 explicitly requested a Grove batch from DJ sets and curated compilations using Keeps/Cuts as filters. This overrides the older source-Likes-first default for this batch.
selection_policy.method: Published curator/label tracklists first, exact standalone version resolution, full-history exclusions, specific Keep comparisons and room-brief screening. No recommendation service generated the selection.
selection_policy.room_brief: Upbeat, fun, happy/hopeful, loving, bouncy, melodic and sexy; no acid/techno or known sad/negative central narratives; avoid chart-pop-led sourcing.
selection_policy.evidence_limit: Musical relationships are attributable-source/editorial hypotheses. No full listening or measured taste model. Three tracks have published positive/playful lyric context; other sample/narrative context is partial or unverified and surfaced in the UI.

feedback_basis.policy: Canonical shared vote with host priority; no prior recording/version reconsiderations.
